# `kaolin/ops/conversions/MeshToPoints.js`

> **Source:** `engine/kaolin/ops/conversions/MeshToPoints.js`

MeshToPoints.js — Sample points from triangle meshes Three sampling strategies: 1. Uniform random — area-weighted triangle sampling (fast) 2. Poisson disk — blue-noise distribution (quality) 3. Farthest point — greedy maximin spacing (LOD/coverage) Output: Float32Array of positions (stride 3) + optional normals Compatible with: - Particle system (direct spawn from sampled points) - MeshToParticlesCompute.js (CPU fallback path) - Point cloud operations (PointCloudOps.js)

## Functions

### `sampleUniform(positions, indices, numSamples, options = {})`

Sample points uniformly on a triangle mesh surface. Uses area-weighted triangle selection + barycentric random point.

**Parameters:**

- `positions` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3
- `indices` *(Uint32Array)* — — stride 3
- `numSamples` *(number)* — — number of points to generate
- `options` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `options.normals` *(boolean)* — — also output per-point normals (default false)
- `options.seed` *(number)* — — random seed (default Date.now())

**Returns:** }

### `samplePoissonDisk(positions, indices, minDist, options = {})`

Poisson disk sampling on a triangle mesh surface. Produces well-distributed (blue-noise) point sets. Uses dart-throwing with spatial hash acceleration.

**Parameters:**

- `positions` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3
- `indices` *(Uint32Array)* — — stride 3
- `minDist` *(number)* — — minimum distance between samples
- `options` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `options.maxAttempts` *(number)* — — attempts per sample (default 30)
- `options.maxSamples` *(number)* — — hard cap on samples (default 100000)
- `options.normals` *(boolean)* — — output normals (default false)

**Returns:** }

### `farthestPointSample(points, numSamples)`

Farthest point sampling from a set of candidate points. Iteratively picks the point farthest from all previously selected points. Produces excellent coverage for LOD and feature-preserving downsampling.

**Parameters:**

- `points` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3 (input candidates)
- `numSamples` *(number)* — — how many to select

**Returns:** }
